items.observation: `PcmAudio.toMono()` and the top-level `toMono(PcmAudio)` each implement the same averaging separately and their contracts differ: when `channels < 1`, the method returns `this` and the function throws `ArgumentError`. Both are public and tested separately (test/audio_decode_test.dart:306-326, test/resample_test.dart:43-66).
items.proposed_fix: Delegate the method to the top-level function with `=> toMono(this)`; the public API is not removed. Make one decision for `channels < 1`, align both test groups to the same expectation, and record it in CHANGELOG.
items.closure_criteria: PcmAudio.toMono() delegates to the top-level toMono function and both paths enforce one shared behavior for channels below 1. test/audio_decode_test.dart and test/resample_test.dart assert the same expectation and CHANGELOG.md records the decision.

items.observation: The value types (PcmAudio, AudioInfo, AudioDecodeException, AudioFormat) live in the same file as the native path and dispatch. The pure Dart WAV decoder imports base for the types; base imports wav_decoder for dispatch.
items.proposed_fix: Move the types and the exception to `lib/src/types.dart`; base, wav_decoder and resample import only that. Update the export lines in `lib/audio_decode.dart`; the names in the show lists and the public API do not change.
items.closure_criteria: PcmAudio, AudioInfo, AudioDecodeException and AudioFormat are defined in lib/src/types.dart and base, wav_decoder and resample import only that file for them. The show lists in lib/audio_decode.dart export the same names as before.

items.observation: The `duration` computation is identical in PcmAudio and AudioInfo.
items.proposed_fix: A private `_durationOf(frameCount, sampleRate)` helper; both getters call it.
items.closure_criteria: Both duration getters call a single private _durationOf(frameCount, sampleRate) helper and the duplicated expression is gone.

items.observation: The int16 limits appear as literals in six places; a named constant (`_int16Scale`) exists at base:136. Float -> int16 multiplies by 32767 (wav_decoder.dart:244); `toFloat32` divides by 32768 (audio_decode_base.dart:88). The asymmetry is not documented.
items.proposed_fix: Named int16 limit constants; one sentence of justification for the asymmetry, a fix and a round-trip test if it is not intentional.
items.closure_criteria: Named int16 limit constants replace the literals in all six places. The 32767 versus 32768 asymmetry carries a justification sentence or is fixed together with a round-trip test.

items.observation: The 'The shared decode path...' comment describing `_decode` sits above `typedef _DecodeFn`.
items.proposed_fix: Move the comment above `_decode` and write a short definition for the typedef.
items.closure_criteria: The shared decode path comment sits directly above _decode and typedef _DecodeFn carries its own short doc comment.

items.observation: The relative `wav_decoder.dart` import comes before `package:ffi` and `bindings.dart` comes after it; `directives_ordering` is off.

items.closure_criteria: Imports in lib/src/audio_decode_base.dart are ordered dart:, package: and relative, and directives_ordering is enabled in analysis_options.yaml.

items.observation: The ctor dartdoc says 'samples.length must be an exact multiple of channels' but does not validate it; `frameCount` silently rounds down.
items.proposed_fix: `assert(channels > 0 && samples.length % channels == 0)` (release behavior unchanged) + a debug test.
items.closure_criteria: The PcmAudio constructor asserts channels > 0 and samples.length % channels == 0. A debug test constructs an invalid PcmAudio and expects the assert to fire.
